description: This Java source file defines the class ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder, a builder for creating immutable JSON objects with unique keys, supporting various set and remove operations, and ensuring thread safety is not guaranteed.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder
classes.description: A final class implementing JsonObjectBuilder, providing methods to build immutable JSON objects with unique keys, supporting set, remove, setAll, and build operations.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set JSON fields with various data types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue, JsonFieldDefinition) with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: setFieldInHierarchy
methods.description: Recursively sets a JsonField in the hierarchy based on a JsonPointer, creating nested objects as needed.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a JSON field identified by a CharSequence key or JsonFieldDefinition, handling nested removal via JsonPointer.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JsonFields from an Iterable, with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Clears all fields from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableJsonObject containing the accumulated fields.
